dataset.title: Incendios forestales de la Comunitat Valenciana (1993-2024)
dataset.owner: Servicio de Prevención de Incendios Forestales, Dirección General de Prevención de Incendios Forestales, Generalitat Valenciana

reasonable_interpretations: GitHub Pages is not prohibited as a hosting technology, but publishing direct public asset URLs is redistribution.
The atlas should disclose reprojection, normalization, partitioning and simplification and should state that the result is not an official ICV product or endorsement.
A root data-license file plus manifest metadata is necessary for traceability, but does not itself prove express acceptance by every direct asset recipient.
unresolved_questions: How must express acceptance be obtained for static public web redistribution and direct GeoJSON URLs?
Is topology-preserving multiscale simplification compatible with the no-alteration/no-denaturalisation condition when fully disclosed?
Which exact attribution formula applies when the dataset owner is DGPIF and the publisher is ICV?
Does the ICV require an explicit indication of modifications beyond attribution and preservation of metadata?
